description: A blank panel that can be resized from 2HP to 64HP by dragging either edge, keeping its leather grain at a fixed scale and saving its width with the patch
notes: a narrow strip along each edge is the resize handle: drag the right edge to move the right boundary and the left edge to move the left one, and the width rounds to whole HP
a newly added panel arrives at 2HP and looks for the nearest modules on its row, expanding to fill a bounded gap; one loaded from a patch keeps its saved width instead
double-clicking the panel or either resize edge measures the surrounding gap again, which is what to do after the neighbouring modules move
Rack checks for collisions, so a width or position it cannot accept returns the panel to where it was
menu: Fit to surrounding gap — measures from the nearest module ending on the left to the nearest beginning on the right and fills that space, capped at 64HP
